features.name: Website
features.description: Public design-system catalog and agent connection guide

steps.name: Open a theme in a separate viewer
steps.screen: Theme card and modal component viewer
data: All 31 IDs map to eight native family specimens
Website colors, radius and Geist stay fixed; original kit CSS is isolated in an iframe
Viewer URL supports direct/reloaded links; legacy ?theme= links migrate to ?preview=
Native dialog keyboard access, Escape, focused heading and focus return; close retains scroll and setup state

steps.name: Choose the website appearance
data: Only the Open Design brand light/dark appearance changes
Old saved design-system selections are ignored without deleting them
Mode persists in the URL and localStorage; storage-disabled browsers still work

steps.name: Compare eight design families
data: GET /api/catalog
Eight real native component thumbnails; expand to all 31 compatible IDs
Search, appearance filters and URL persistence
Native palette strips retain original appearance and never recolor the website
Kit/composer/CSS/image hashes verify gallery provenance

steps.name: Preview actual installed components
steps.screen: Separate modal viewer and standalone sample workspace
data: /?specimen=<representative-id> opens the full native workspace separately
Variants clearly identify their representative family preview
Licensed fonts and registry source copies verified by src/previews/manifest.json
Sample forms/dialog reset when reopened

steps.name: Inspect theme tokens
data: GET /registry/:theme/globals.json

steps.name: Install from the front-page guide
steps.screen: Hero installation panel beside the product title
data: Six client formats: Codex, Claude Code/Desktop, Cursor, VS Code and server URL
Exact commands/configuration; keyboard tabs and clipboard success/denial recovery
Core defaults to /mcp/core with 11 tools; no hero specimen iframe
No client configuration is changed automatically

steps.name: Choose Essentials or All tools
steps.screen: Tool options disclosure in the installation guide
data: Full /mcp remains available
Profile changes reset copy feedback and update the current client format
